properties.name: The v0.93.1 release cut
properties.rationale: The owner said "Let's continue with the release" on 2026-10-28 and chose 0.93.1; the tag push stays his. Patch by CHANGELOG's Versioning table: since v0.93.0 main holds only #811, a fix to the HTTP server (a registry raises its soft open-file limit and warns when its designs may not fit) plus an additive /readyz line and two headers; no tool, argument, skill or schema change. Measured against the published 0.93.0 binary (linux-x86_64 archive sha256 3a889ee7..., checked against checksums.txt): 199 tools on both, none added, removed or changed; 35 skills, none changed; get_instructions unchanged; the schema stamp equal but for its version (28 node, 69 edge types, same enums), so no upgrade doc is owed. Nothing is deprecated or removed, so no notice to the MCP users is owed. The --call setup gains nothing; the /readyz line, the raise and the warning were each checked on the 0.93.1 build against 0.93.0's behaviour. The binary this box serves is rebuilt after the tag (step 9), not in this PR. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: reflow2 0.93.1 is cut in PR release/v0.93.1: every version claim moves 0.93.0 -> 0.93.1 (Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, reflow2.toml, AGENTS.md's two lines, the five site pages), the one changelog.d fragment (#811) is assembled under [0.93.1] with the opening, surface, stamp and "In your setup" paragraphs, the schema snapshot is re-blessed (version line only), and site/setup.html's team-server section says what #811 adds (the registry's open-file raise and warning, the /readyz open-files line). rel:v0931 is recorded, pinned to epoch:v0931-cut with the increment's 1 ChangeEvent and the cut's 8 acceptances, deployed to env:ci, env:container and env:dev as rel:v0930 was, and its manifest derived (913 INCLUDES).
